rows.evidence_summary: FY2019 10-K 'Item 1. Business' overview: 'We have one precision therapy approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration...and are currently advancing multiple investigational medicines in clinical development' - a section header names both 'Avapritinib and BLU-263' as the company's Systemic Mastocytosis program compounds; the same document and the event's own press release separately reference an active RET-altered-cancer program (pralsetinib/BLU-667), a distinct compound from avapritinib.
